name: Candidate confuses CTC with in-hand monthly pay

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Any questions for us about the offer structure?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Yes sir — the offer letter said 6.5 LPA CTC but isn't CTC the same as in-hand monthly? So I'll take home 6.5 LPA, right? I thought CTC was the monthly pay I would actually receive.
